name: Deepavali Lamps & Rangoli
summary: Twelve clay diyas, a round geometric rangoli and two hanging marigold garlands.
description: Original twelve-diya display on a 2.4 m round, three-colour geometric petal rangoli, with two suspended marigold garlands. Hollow clay bowls, wicks and small static flame meshes; no text, brands, religious figures or external assets.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / Codex-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python; three plain shared materials; no external models, images, textures, fonts or scripts.
accuracy_notes: Measured export dimensions are X width, Y height, Z depth. The lamp group fits inside a 2 x 2 m placement envelope; the supplied floor is the larger 2.4 m round mosaic, not a separate square slab. Four overhead fixing loops indicate hanging positions; mounting structure is not included. Flames are static geometry with no emitted lights, animation or fire simulation. Physical rigging, devices, WebKit and full-mall performance are not verified.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and materials created for the owner project. No third-party assets.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
material_notes: Editable source components; delivery GLB batches geometry into three opaque material meshes. The rangoli is a single tessellated closed plaque without coplanar overlays.
